title: Entire directional products and symmetric sphere contractions control centered complex quantum coefficients

statement.quantifiers: Every fixed d>=2, PI rho_N with actual tau>=kappa I and all-direction centered MGF<=A exp(BNt²); all support degrees2<=k<=r<N.
statement.assertion: For Hermitian traceless HS basis F_a, centered A_a=F_a-Tr(tau F_a)I, complex G_ab=Tr(tau A_a A_b)>=kappa I. Exact Petz support Parseval starts k=2. Real symmetric coefficient tensors d_k obey T_k=||d_k||F²<=A² alpha_(d²-1,k)/k! *[2e(B+2)N/k]^k/binom(N,k)², alpha_(m,k)=m(m+2)...(m+2k-2). This yields chi<=A² y²/(1-y), y=e(B+2)(d²+1)r/[kappa(N-r)]<1.
assumptions: Actual one-body centering, permutation symmetry and faithful marginal; no rho/reference commutation.
Full complex Gram includes imaginary commutators; coefficient tensors are real because observables act on distinct sites.
Concentration for every Hermitian direction and every real t, fixed uniform constants.

inputs: Uniform directional concentration and marginal lower eigenvalue bound; these are supplied promises unless separately acquired.
outputs: Universal full-local-state Petz bound, then natural-log relative entropy <=log(1+chi).
interface.precision: Finite analytic coefficient estimate, inclusive real-direction coverage; growing-d/marginal floor losses must be retained.
costs: Promise acquisition, state preparation and all-direction certification not supplied.
No generic matched entanglement upper: a fully separable biased product mixture attains the quadratic order.

proof_mechanism: For complex v, HS-traceless U=sum v_a F_a gives Trtau(U-TrtauU I)* (U-TrtauU I)>=kappa||v||².
Use centered product basis: independent support blocks have Gram G tensor k and actual centering removes degree1 exactly.
Same-axis Q_i commute across sites, so |prod(I+zQ_i)|<=exp(2N|z|²)exp((Re z)sumQ_i); trace positivity imports only real-t MGF.
Entire polynomial directional degree-k coefficient is binom(N,k)d_k[u,...,u]; optimize Cauchy circle.
Sphere moment pairings: k! cross pairings give full tensor Frobenius norm, other internal contractions give nonnegative squared trace tensors.
Binomial/falling-factorial bounds sum supports fromdegree2 into a geometric series; retain baselineN if MGFvariance varies.
obstructions: Real covariance in place of complex Gram is invalid for noncommuting local operators.
Mean Casimir or a finite set of variances does not establish the uniform MGF; N237 counterexample.
Chi-square lower alone need not imply trace/KL nonvanishing; N239 counterexample.
